question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

 Despite the _______________ weather, the festival was a huge success.
solution:
The correct answer is '**inclement**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**inclement**" refers to unpleasantly cold or wet weather. (अप्रिय मौसम)
 
• Despite bad weather conditions, the festival was successful, making "inclement" the best choice for this context.
 
• The other options: "**temperate**," "**mild**," and "**balmy**" all describe pleasant or favorable weather, which does not fit the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Despite the inclement__ weather, the festival was a huge success.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Temperate (सामान्य)**: refers to moderate or mild weather conditions.
 
• **Mild (हल्का)**: refers to gentle or not extreme weather.
 
• **Balmy (सुखद)**: refers to pleasantly warm weather.
